description: Hochwasser-Überflutungsflächen Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. Overview of flooded areas. The areas that are statistically flooded by flood events every 30, 100 and 300 years are identified. These designations are based on precipitation and discharge studies for the respective catchment area of the river. The representation takes the form of flooding areas. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding areas Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gefahrenzonen, Hochwasser, Gefahrenzonenplan, Überflutungsflächen, Abflussuntersuchung, ViennaGIS. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHP, GIF, CSV, JPEG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
